title: ～ばかりか〜も (〜bakari ka 〜 mo)
shortExplanation: Expresses 'not only... but also'; emphasizing the extent of something.
longExplanation: The ～ばかりか〜も grammar point is used to express the idea of 'not only... but also' in a sentence. It emphasizes the extent to which something applies, showing a certain component or factor is not the only relevant one.
formation: Noun/Verb/Adjective + ばかりか + Noun/Verb/Adjective + も

examples.jp: 彼はかわいいばかりか、賢くもある。
examples.romaji: Kare wa kawaii bakari ka, kashikoku mo aru.
examples.en: He is not only cute but also smart.

examples.jp: このレストランは味が良いばかりかサービスも素晴らしいです。
examples.romaji: Kono resutoran wa aji ga yoi bakari ka saabisu mo subarashii desu.
examples.en: This restaurant not only has great taste but also wonderful service.

examples.jp: 彼女は日本語が上手ばかりか英語も話せる。
examples.romaji: Kanojo wa nihongo ga jouzu bakari ka eigo mo hanaseru.
examples.en: She can speak not only Japanese but also English.

examples.jp: 彼は歌が上手いばかりかダンスもうまい。
examples.romaji: Kare wa uta ga umai bakari ka dansu mo umai.
examples.en: He is not only good at singing but also dancing.
